concepts.def: Doctrine of one God in three Persons: Father, Son and Holy Spirit; affirmed at Council of Nicaea 325 AD.
Belief that Jesus is God made flesh; 'the Word became flesh' (John 1:14); central to Christmas and Christology.
Jesus' death by crucifixion under Pontius Pilate and rising on the third day; 1 Corinthians 15 calls it 'of first importance'.
Reconciliation between God and humanity through Christ's sacrifice; Romans 5:8 'God showed his love while we were still sinners'.
Disobedience to God's will; original sin (Augustine) inherited from Adam and Eve; redeemed through Christ.
Doctrine of last things: Second Coming, Final Judgement, heaven and hell; Apostles' Creed affirms resurrection of the body.
